excerpt.zh: 我们在[this.GetName]的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报星尘风暴它对水过滤系统有不利影响。随着颗粒在星球地下水中沉淀，形成的矿浆堵塞了关键的基础设施。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on [this.GetName] report that the Stardust Storm is having adverse effects on water filtration systems. As the particles settle in the planet's groundwater, the resulting mineral slurry is clogging key infrastructure points.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.GetName]的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报星尘风暴它对水过滤系统有不利影响。随着颗粒在星球地下水中沉淀，形成的矿浆堵塞了关键的基础设施。
texts.en: Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on [this.GetName] report that the Stardust Storm is having adverse effects on water filtration systems. As the particles settle in the planet's groundwater, the resulting mineral slurry is clogging key infrastructure points.

texts.zh: 在研究水培堵塞的过程中，我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]发现，矿化的浆液本身对石质生理学人口实际上既美味又有营养。在对殖民地的过滤系统进行了一些小调整之后，它们大量生产了一种新的季节性饮料，可以供应到风暴结束。
texts.en: While investigating the hydroponic blockages, our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] discovered that the mineralized slurry itself is actually both delicious and nutritious when consumed by those with lithoid physiology. After making a few minor adjustments to the colony's filtration systems they have mass-produced a new seasonal drink with which to wait out the storm.

texts.zh:
由此导致的水培故障严重影响了星球上的农业，也导致了安全饮用水的短缺。

这个问题如果不加以处理，可能会对我们的供水造成长期的影响。幸运的是，我们的[owner.GetEngineerPlural]有信心他们可以创造更强大的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
texts.en:
The resulting hydroponic failures are heavily impacting the planet's agriculture, as well as leading to shortages in safe drinkable water.

This problem could have long-lasting consequences on our water supply if not dealt with. Fortunately, our [owner.GetEngineerPlural] are confident they can create more robust filtration systems to address the issue.

texts.zh: 星尘风暴对[this.GetName]的影响导致了水过滤系统被许多不可溶的矿物泥浆阻塞了。我们必须改建出更强劲的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
texts.en: The impact of a Stardust Storm on [this.GetName] has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.

texts.zh:
[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]解决了[this.GetName]上的水培阻塞和用水短缺的问题。殖民地的水供应网络得到了升级，现在可以滤去星尘风暴所带来的复杂杂质。

这些对用水基础设施的改进还可以用来提升[Owner.GetName]上的灌溉作业。
texts.en:
The [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have dealt with the hydroponic blockages and water shortages on [this.GetName]. The colony's water supply network has been improved and can now filter out complex impurities such as those introduced by the Stardust Storm.

These improvements to our water infrastructure can be repurposed to improve irrigation efforts across the [Owner.GetName].
